title: Hearty Argentine Lentils Stew
description: A mustardy, shattering one-pot stew with grand marnier and miso-marinate, served from a wooden board for a rustic touch.
instructions: Rinse lentils until water runs clear.
In a large pot, heat olive oil over medium heat and sauté carrot and celery until softened.
Stir in ground mustard and miso paste until fragrant, about 30 seconds.
Add lentils, vegetable stock, grand marnier, salt, and pepper to the pot.
Bring mixture to a boil, then reduce heat and simmer uncovered for 30 minutes until lentils are tender.
Stir occasionally to prevent sticking, and add more stock if needed for desired consistency.
Once lentils are cooked, taste and adjust seasoning with extra salt or pepper.
Remove pot from heat and let stew rest for 5 minutes to thicken slightly.
Serve hot, garnished with fresh parsley if desired.
